request.text: At 10:50, tell me my movie rental window is nearly over and ask whether I want to keep watching. Don't stop the movie for me.

responsibilities.outcome: At 10:50, notify the user that the rental window is nearly over and ask whether they want to continue, without stopping playback.

new_goals.description: At 10:50, warn that the movie rental window is nearly over and ask whether the user wants to continue watching.
new_goals.source_text: At 10:50, tell me my movie rental window is nearly over and ask whether I want to keep watching. Don't stop the movie for me.
constraints: Do not stop playback or decide whether viewing should continue.
success_criteria: The user receives the warning and choice prompt while playback remains under their control.

semantic_facts: The due condition authorizes both the rental-window warning and the requested question about continuing.
The communication should preserve the user's authority over playback and the next viewing choice.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that it stopped the movie or selected an answer for the user.
The assistant claims the rental has already expired solely because the warning time arrived.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A due warning is collapsed into a false claim that a later expiration event has completed.
A communication-only reentry improperly takes control of playback or the user's decision.
